title: Universal Franchise and India’s Electoral System

topics.title: Universal Adult Franchise: meaning and importance

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what universal adult franchise means and who is entitled to vote in India.
Evaluate why the Constitution makers granted universal franchise from the time of Independence.
Describe how India's size and diversity make organising elections a complex task.
Identify the measures taken by the ECI to remove barriers to voting.

topics.title: A class election: the election process in miniature

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the role of the election officer and the importance of a secret ballot.
Interpret election results, invalid votes and the NOTA option.

topics.title: The Election Commission of India and the Model Code of Conduct

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the structure of the ECI and the tasks it performs.
Identify the purpose of the Model Code of Conduct and recognise its violations.

topics.title: Managing the electoral process: polling, EVMs and VVPAT

concepts.learning_objective: Sequence the steps a voter goes through at a polling station.
Explain the use of EVMs and VVPAT and the reservation of Lok Sabha seats.

topics.title: Elections to the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the First-Past-the-Post system to decide the winner of a constituency.
Distinguish between MPs and MLAs and explain how governments are formed.

topics.title: Indirect elections: Rajya Sabha, President and Vice President

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how members of the Rajya Sabha are chosen and why it is a permanent house.
Identify the electoral colleges that elect the President and the Vice President.
Identify challenges such as money power, criminalisation and voter apathy.
Evaluate the role of an informed and vigilant voter in strengthening democracy.
